caption: Fontana Maggiore, Perugia
composition: Medieval polygonal fountain before Perugia Cathedral and Palazzo dei Priori · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The fountain fills the left and center foreground, its two polygonal basins stacked on carved panels and wide steps, a bronze figure group crowning the top. Behind it the crenellated stone palazzo rises at the left-center with its square towers. To the right the cathedral front with its rose window and pointed portals faces the square. The modelled scenario is 23 September 2026 at 11:21 Europe/Rome: bright late-morning sun on the pale stone.
